DOP: bhaddaka bhadraka mf (-ikā) n. and n. [ cf S. bhadraka], 1. ( mfn. ) good; excellent; auspicious, fortunate; pleasant, pleasing; Vin I 272, 38 (ayaṃ deva amhākaṃ Jīvako vejjo taruṇo bhadrako); 312, 17 (~o kho ayaṃ āvuso āvāsiko bhikkhu); III 137, 25 (bhaddikāhi sassūhi ~ehi sasurehi); V 144, 6* (~o te ummaggo yoniso paripucchasi; Sp 1348, 6 : bhaddikā te paññā, Ce so; Se ~ā; Be, Ee ~ā te pañhā); D II 174, 15 (~aṃ vata bho hatthiyānaṃ sace damathaṃ upeyyā ti); III 226, 29 (bhikkhu uppannaṃ ~aṃ samādhinimittaṃ anurakkhati, Ce, Ee, Se so; Be bhadrakaṃ); S IV 252, 9 (~o āvuso maggo bhaddikā paṭipadā etassa nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya); A I 130, 2* (upeti ~aṃ ṭhānaṃ yattha gantvā na socati); 261, 27 foll. (tassa … pūtimanokammantassa na ~aṃ maraṇaṃ hoti na bhaddikā kālakiriyā; Mp III 348, 5 foll.: yo hi bhītabhīto marati tassa na ~aṃ maraṇaṃ hoti, yo apāye paṭisandhiṃ gaṇhāti tassa na bhaddikā kālakiriyā hoti); IV 169, 11 (mā aññe ~e bhikkhū dūsesī ti); It 27, 5* foll. (~ena ca sīlena bhaddikāya ca diṭṭhiyā); Pv 1:3 (kammaṃ katvāna ~aṃ); Th 391 (so virūhati saddhamme khette bījaṃ va ~aṃ); Ja I 115, 29 (mayhaṃ sakalalokassāpi tav’ eva pabbajjā bhaddikā); 269, 31* (na cāyaṃ bhaddikā surā); III 182, 20 (~ena nakkhattena maṅgalakiriyaṃ katvā); IV 451, 4* (vipāko hoti bhadrako); Nidd I 365, 18 (sundaraṃ ~aṃ kalyāṇaṃ); Ap 34, 13 (tamh’ eva ~e kappe; Ap-a 267, 19 : pañcabuddhapaṭimaṇḍitattā ~e nāma kappe); Cp 2:5:3 (ṭhānaṃ addasa ~aṃ); Mil 375, 20 (bījaṃ … ~e khette vuttaṃ); Vism 312, 2 (supinaṃ passanto pi ~am eva supinaṃ passati); Mp I 169, 25 (amma ~e kāle āgatā si); Dhp-a I 214, 4 (~o vata no uttaribhaṅgo uppanno); III 446, 5 (~ena divasena); Ud-a 290, 12 (bhaddikā eva Suppabuddhassa gati na pāpikā ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee ~ā); Pj II 576, 12 (~o no rājā laddho bhaddikā rājaparisā ti); — 2. ( n. ) a good thing, good; good fortune; Ja III 252, 10 (sace … etth’ eva … imaṃ divasaṃ vaseyyaṃ bhadrakaṃ vata assā ti); Sv 866, 29 (~aṃ vat’ assa sace āloko pātubhaveyyā ti); Ps IV 6, 2 (~aṃ te bhadde kataṃ); Mp I 269, 20 (ahaṃ imaṃ mantaṃ uggaṇhitvā sakalajambudīpe jeṭṭhako bhavissāmi evaṃ sante tumhākaṃ pi ~aṃ bhavissatī ti, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee bhaddaṃ); Dhp-a II 246, 16 (~aṃ esa vadati); — bhadrakā in Ee at Ja V 254, 29* (bahū pi bhadrakā ete) is perhaps wr; Be, Ce, Se bahūni samaṇabhadrāni; — bhaddakassa in Ee at Dhp-a III 151, 4 is wr; Be bhatakassa; Ce, Se bhaṭakassa; — ifc see upari-; — abhaddaka , mfn. and n. , 1. ( mfn. ) not good; unpleasant; Ja V 480, 21´ (jīvitaṃ hi tassa āyatiṃ ~-ttā dujjīvitaṃ nāma, Se so; Ce anāyatibhaddakattā va; Ee anāyatabhadrakattā; Be different ); Ap 101, 13 (vācaṃ bhāsiṃ ~aṃ); Pv-a 114, 12 (pāpako ti ~o); Th-a II 186, 21 (~-taraṃ akalyāṇataraṃ); — 2. ( n. ) wrong-doing; mischief; Ud-a 426, 31 (pāpakaṃ ~aṃ … pajahati); Pv-a 116, 19 (pāpena ~ena aniṭṭhena bādhati); — atibhaddaka , atibhadraka, mfn. , very good; very auspicious; Mil 234, 28 (atibhadrakaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ); Ps II 78, 31 (~o ayaṃ dhammapariyāyo); — subhaddaka , subhadraka, mfn. , very good; very fine; M III 268, 16 (~ā vat’ ime Sunāparantakā manussā yaṃ me na-y-ime pāṇinā pahāraṃ dentī ti) = S IV 61, 15 quoted Pj I 149, 11 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee subhadrakā); Ja III 82, 24* (catuppado ~o c’ eva supesalo ca); Ap 339, 12 (~o tvaṃ manuja); 547, 24 (jiṇṇena dhammo ’yaṃ caritabbo ~o).
CPD: a-bhaddaka , mfn. [ cf. sa. a-bhadra], inauspi- cious, unlucky; Ap 101, 13 (vācaṃ bhāsiṃ ~aṃ); n. subst. , ~aṃ anatthaṃ, Pv-a 116, 2 (= 'pāpaṃ'); pāpena ~ena aniṭṭhena [ v. l. anatthakena] bādhati, Pv-a 116, 19 (= 'pāpena hiṃsati'). a-bhaddaka

ābhādhātu.p: [Ābhā+dhātu] (thī) CL=7 Ābhādhāta. (A) The nature/characteristic of radiance such as sun light, moon light  and which is ideology that is not only any living being but also life, Rūpa dhāta. (Rūpa means appearance). (B) Jhana which is together with (āloka)kasiuṇaḥ and  concentrated on the radiance (that āloka)kasiuṇaḥ Which is ideology that is not only any living being but also life. (Dhāta means [Buddhist Scriptures] 1 (a) the basic property of matter such as solidity,heat, cohesion or fulidity, and volatility or mobility (commonly described as earth, fire, water and air) (b) the essence or quality (or) mineral (or) faecal matter).
a: အာဘာဓာတု(ထီ)

အာဘာဓာတ်။(က)နေရောင်လရောင်စသော အရောင်အလင်းဟူသော-ဓာတ်သဘော-သတ္တလည်းမဟုတ် ဇီဝလည်း မဟုတ်သော သဘောတရား၊ ရူပဓာတ်။(ခ)အရောင်အလင်း(အာလောက)ကသိုဏ်းနှင့်တကွ ထိုကသိုဏ်းကို အာရုံပြုသော ဈာန်ဟူသော- ဓာတ်သဘော-သတ္တလည်းမဟုတ် ဇီဝလည်းမဟုတ်သော သဘောတရား။
